text: smithay 0.7 DmabufState::create_global offers linux-dmabuf without feedback, and decade offers no wl_drm either, so a client's Mesa gets no DRM device (logs 'failed to get driver name for fd -1') and can fall back to software GL. ghostty then dropped its text above about 3000x1900 logical px. dmabuf_global() in src/server/compositor.rs passes the render node as default feedback: DmabufFeedbackBuilder::new(gpu.node.dev_id(), ...) and create_global_with_default_feedback. Found 2026-11-07.
